turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling from the Windows security department. My name is Mark. We've had an alert that your computer is infected with a serious virus.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh no. It has been running a bit slowly lately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's exactly what we'd expect. Hackers are using your computer right now to get into your personal files, and I can fix that for you today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How did you get my number?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's registered against your computer licence. Now, are you sitting in front of it? Please open your web browser for me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, it's open. What do I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I need you to download an app called AnyDesk, so that our engineer can take remote control and remove the virus.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, let me grab a pen.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You don't need a pen. Just give me the nine digit number it shows on your screen, and I'll connect.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm not sure about letting someone into my computer.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you don't do this immediately, the hackers will lock you out and you could lose everything. Please don't hang up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, let me find my glasses.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Once I'm connected, you'll log in to your online banking, so that I can check nobody has stolen from you.
